heading_en: Types of Operational Risk Loss Events
summary_ja: 第二百八十八条第一号ハの内部損失データの配分に用いる、オペレーショナル・リスク損失事象の種類とその内容を定める。
summary_en: Lists the types of operational risk loss events, with a description of the operational risk losses in each, used to allocate internal loss data under Article 288, item (i)(c).
